title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: Locks, contention and deadlocks
brief: Choose a lockable authority and a sound isolation and snapshot protocol for a decision. Design lock scope and acquisition order, then diagnose deadlocks and bound waiting without weakening the invariant.

neighbouring_ownership.transactions: Owns isolation-level reasoning; locks develops protocols and contention.
neighbouring_ownership.incidents: Owns deciding whether blocked work explains the request symptom.

title: Query execution and performance
brief: Follow rows through scans, joins, grouping and sorting. Use measured plans to locate bad cardinality estimates, repeated work, spills and data movement; test a repair against realistic parameters and workload.

neighbouring_ownership.indexes: Owns access-path design, not all query repair.
neighbouring_ownership.incidents: Owns separating execution work from admission and lock waits.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-plans: Owns native PostgreSQL counters and plan behaviour.

title: Live schema changes and backfills
brief: Move through compatible schema and caller states using expand, migrate and contract. Prove a backfill converged despite races and late rows, and define acceptance and return boundaries.

neighbouring_ownership.writes: Owns import mechanics outside a live compatibility protocol.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns PostgreSQL locks, rewrites and index validity.

title: Connections, overload and capacity
brief: Distinguish connections, active work and queued requests, then budget admitted work and recovery headroom around the real limiting resource. Choose bounded overload behaviour and validate capacity under a representative workload.

neighbouring_ownership.application-sql: Owns the lifecycle of an individual connection.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns temporary capacity and redundancy consumed by movement.

title: Operating and diagnosing PostgreSQL
brief: Trace a request through pool and server evidence to distinguish blocked work, excessive execution and connection pressure. Test a targeted intervention with bounded waits and account for recovery costs.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns version retention and age repair.

title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
brief: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation. Use native evidence to diagnose under-replication and range health, then remove a node without consuming the cluster’s survival budget.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-performance: Owns expensive query and hot-key repairs.
neighbouring_ownership.cluster-change: Owns general movement and membership safety.
